Commentary.Commentary: We are set for the run chase! The South African players stride out to the middle to take their respective fielding positions. Followed by the two big guns  - Paul Stirling and Kevin O'Brien. Bjorn Fortuin to begin with the ball.

So, the hosts have a huge mountain to climb. In the last two games, their batting was not up to the mark. It will be a good end to this series if they are able to chase the target of 190 runs. It is All or nothing for Ireland today. Join us for the chase in a while.

Benjamin White, the debutant is up for a chat. He says it's a really good feeling to play for Ireland. Goes onto say yes he was nervous, he would look to grow as a cricketer. Says there are no words to describe this feeling.

This was clearly not how the hosts envisioned their innings! The bowlers kept probing good lines and lengths, but hardly found any success. The game was almost taken away from them, in the process. Thanks to Simi Singh, as Ireland found the first breakthrough in the 16th over. The debutant Benjamin White dropped a catch of Reeza Hendricks and that proved to be costly. But overall, they tried hard but today just wasn't their day. Barry McCarthy got a wicket of Bavuma in the death overs but it was too little, too late.

What a performance by the opening pair of South Africa! The skipper, Temba Bavuma led from the front along with Reeza Hendricks. They kept things quiet at the start, but after the 10th over they changed gears and up the ante. Both the batsmen went onto score half-centuries. They built a solid stand of 127 before Hendricks got out. Bavuma though continued to remain on the counter-attacking mode and started taking on each and every bowler but had to walk back for a well-made 72. After that, David Miller and Heinrich Klaasen helped the Proteas to post a huge total of 189 for 2. This is also the highest score of the series.
Two byes! Slower ball outside off, Klaasen looks to paddle scoop it but misses. The keeper fails to collect the ball and the batters take a couple of byes. South Africa finish with 189/2.

NO BALL! Low full toss on off, David Miller heaves it straight towards deep mid-wicket. Simi Singh gobbles up the catch with ease. But the umpire signals a no ball as Mark Adair has overstepped. Free Hit coming up...

Length ball on off, Heinrich Klaasen throws the kitchen sink at it heaves it over covers. Paul Stirling runs to his right and attempts to catch the ball. He puts out his right hand and it goes off the fingertips. Tough chance. Great effort though. A run taken.
High full toss on middle, Miller works it towards deep square leg for one.
Very full and outside off, David Miller creams it through covers. Shane Getkate runs to his left and puts in a sliding dive. Saves a certain boundary there. Excellent effort from him.
Length ball on middlle, Heinrich Klaasen pulls it towards square leg for one.

FOUR! Full toss on middle, Heinrich Klaasen swings his bat but miscues. The ball goes off the top edge towards the third man region for a boundary. Not where he intended but won't mind as long as the runs come.
Mark Adair comes back into the attack to bowl the final over. His figures 3-0-27-0 so far.
SIX! WHACKED! Short of a length on off, David Miller muscles it over long on for half-a-dozen. He moves onto 32 off just 14 balls.
Good length ball outside off, the ball keeps a little low. Miller looks to work it on the leg side but gets an outside edge. The ball goes past the keeper to the fine leg region. Two taken.
Slower delivery on off, punched towards the mid off region for a single.
Short ball on off, pulled away towards deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! Full and on off, David Miller smacks it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Killer Miller as they say it.
David Miller has gone down with a cramp. The physio has come out to have a look. Miller is up again and he is fit to continue.
Full length ball on middle, Miller whips it towards deep square leg. He pushes hard for the second run and gets it comfortably at the end.
Craig Young comes back into the attack.
Wide yorker, Miller jams it out to short third man. He keeps the strike picking up a single.
Who will come out next? It is going to be Heinrich Klaasen.

OUT! TAKEN! That's the end of Bavuma's stay! Short ball on middle, Temba Bavuma moves across and pulls it towards deep square leg. Mark Adair watches the ball closely and settles under it. He holds onto that. A safe catch indeed. Temba Bavuma departs after a well-made 72.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b Barry McCarthy

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on middle, Bavuma flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Excellent running between the wickets.
Length ball on off, Miller cuts it towards point for a single.
FOUR! Make that two in a row! Full again on off, David Miller pushes it towards wide of long off for another boundary. Great start to the over for the Proteas.
FOUR! Well-executed! Wide yorker outside off, David Miller extends his arms and slashes it towards deep backward point for a boundary.
Barry McCarthy comes back into the attack.
Length ball on middle, Miller eases it down to long on for a run.
On middle, Bavuma pushes it towards long on for one.
SIX! BANG! Length ball on middle, Temba Bavuma waits for the ball and hoicks it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Got enough wings on that to clear the boundary. He moves onto 69.
FOUR! Bavuma will look to shift gears now! Back of a length on middle, Temba Bavuma makes room for himself and pulls it to the vacant deep mid-wicket area for a boundary.
On a length on off, Miller taps it towards third man for one.
On a length on middle, Bavuma smacks it towards deep mid-wicket but only for a single.
WIDE! Sprays one down the leg side, Bavuma leaves it alone. Wided.
Mark Adair comes back into the attack.

FOUR! Straightaway on duty! Short and on middle, David Miller rocks back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder at the deep puts in a dive but in vain as he parries the ball over the ropes.
Tossed up on middle, Bavuma works it on the leg side for one.
On middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a single. Miller is off the mark.
Loopy ball on off, Miller looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. Simi Singh appeals for an LBW but nothing from the umpire.
Who will come out next? It is going to be David Miller.

OUT! TAKEN! Simi Singh has the last laugh! Tosses it up outside off, Reeza Hendricks tries to do something innovative and attempts a reverse sweep. He completely misses out on it though. The ball takes off the gloves and carries through to the keeper. Lorcan Tucker takes a good sharp catch behind the sticks.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Shot of class! Tossed up outside off, Reeza Hendricks lifts it over covers for a boundary. He has started to shift gears now.
Simi Singh comes into the attack now. His figures read 3-0-17-0 so far.
Full again on middle, Bavuma flicks it towards deep mid-wicket. Two is the call and gets it comfortably.
On a length on off, Hendricks cuts it to point for one.
FOUR! WOW! Full and on middle, Reeza Hendricks stays deep in the crease and whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length ball on middle, Bavuma strides forward and works it off the outside edge to point. A single taken.
FOUR! Nicely played. A length ball, on off. Bavuma stays back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. The ball goes into the boundary on a bounce.
A length ball, on off. Hendricks pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Craig Young comes back into the attack. Conceded 13 runs in his two overs.
Floated it up around off, Hendricks pushes it towards covers for a single.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Reeza Hendricks cuts it fine and cuts it late to third man for a boundary.
Tossed up, full and outside off, Bavuma drags it towards sweeper cover. That brings up his half-century as well. Both the batsmen are looking solid.
This is eased down to long off for a run.
Around off, Hendricks lifts it over covers for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Full and on middle, Reeza Hendricks prods and creams it through covers for a boundary. Brings up his fifty as well. 100 up for South Africa too.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Reeza Hendricks nudges it to short fine leg for a single.
A length ball, on off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! The misfield proved to be costly. A full length ball, on off. Bavuma moves across and scoops it towards fine leg. The man in the deep make a mess of it and the ball goes through and towards the boundary. He moves to 48.
On off, Hendricks flicks it to mid-wicket for a single
A length ball, on off, Hendricks pushes it through covers for a couple.
A length ball, on off. Bavuma pushes it to mid off for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! These two batters are taking the run rate up now. Flatter and outside off, Reeza Hendricks stays back and cuts it through covers for a boundary. Moves to 43.
A length ball, on off, Bavuma nudges it to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! In the gap! A length ball, on off. Bavuma shimmies down the track and punches it through covers. The outfield is fast and the ball races away to the boundary.
A length ball, on off, Hendricks puhses it to cover for a single.
Floated and on off, Hendricks nudges it to the right of long on for a couple. Good running.
Tossed up, on middle, Bavuma nudges it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shane Getkate is brought into the attack.
Flatter and on off, Bavuma cuts it through covers for a run.
On off, Reeza Hendricks sweeps it through the leg side for a single.

DROPPED AND SIX! Looped up, on off. Reeza Hendricks stays back and powers it to towards long on. Benjamin White gets under it but fails to get a hold of it, instead he parries it into the boundary. Something the young man would want to forget as soon as possible.
Flatter and outside off, Bavuma pushes it through covers for a single.
Full and on off, Reeza Hendricks sweeps it through the leg side for a single.
Loopy ball, on off. Bavuma pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Simi Singh is back on. His figures read 2-0-6-0.
Full and outside off, Reeza Hendricks looks to slog sweep but gets an inside edge onto the pads. South Africa are 63/0 at the halfway mark.
Short and on middle, nudged towards mid-wicket for a single.
On off, driven towards covers for one.
Slower through the air outside off, Hendricks goes down on his knee and looks to sweep but misses.
Short and on off, Bavuma smacks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Hendricks heaves it towards long on for one.
Good length ball on off, Hendricks pushes it towards covers for one. Excellent over from Mark Adair. Just four runs from it.
Short of a length ball on middle, Reeza Hendricks looks to upper-cut but fails to connect.
On middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length outside off, Bavuma gets himself in an awkward position and chips it towards mid on. He takes a couple of runs.
On a length on off, Bavuma blocks it out.
Good length ball on middle, angling in. Bavuma looks to defend but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Mark Adair comes back into the attack. His figures 1-0-8-0 so far.
Full and outside off, Hendricks looks to drive but misses.
Short on middle, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
On off, Bavuma works it towards covers for one.
FOUR! Fractionally short again on middle, Temba Bavuma smacks it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Quicker ball on the stumps, worked on the leg side for one.
Short one on middle, Hendricks pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder there does well to put in a dive. He parries it to the covering fielder. Saves two for the side.
Slower and fuller on the pads, Bavuma pushes it back to the bowler. 10 runs coming from that over.
Good length delivery on middle, angling in. Hendricks tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, Bavuma looks to drive but gets an inside edge. The ball goes towards square leg and a run is taken.
SIX! Mighty hit! Bangs a short ball on middle, Temba Bavuma gets into the position early. He pulls it over deep square leg for a maximum. Hits the first maximum of the innings as well.
Length ball on off, Hendricks steers it towards deep point for a single.
On a length on middle, Bavuma pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
On middle, worked on the leg side for one. End of the Powerplay. South Africa are 35/0.
Tossed up on middle, Temba Bavuma goes for the reverse sweep but doesn't connect it. He gets hit on the gloves as he attempts.
Floated it up outside off, Bavuma punches it off the back foot towards covers.
Loopy ball on middle, Hendricks works it towards mid-wicket for another single.
Tossed up on middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off, Hendricks pushes it towards covers for one.
Simi Singh is back into the attack.
A length ball, on middle. Hendricks flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, on off, Bavuma pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length ball, around off, nipping in. Hendricks stays back and taps it to point. They take a quick single.
A length ball, outside off. Hendricks pushes it to cover.
FOUR! Pulled away nicely. A length ball, on off, Hendricks stays back and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
A touch short, on off, Bavuma pushes it to backward point for a single.
Mark Adair comes into the attack now.
On a length on off, Bavuma works it towards square leg for a single.
A length ball, on off, pushed to covers for a single.
Good length ball, on off, Bavuma nudges it to mid-wicket for a run.

A loud appeal for LBW but turned down. A touch short, on leg. Bavuma comes down the track and looks to flick it but misses. The ball comes in contact of the pads and deflect back to the bowler. Going down and the height was the problem.
FOUR! Gifted! A full length delivery, on the pads. Bavuma flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
A length ball, on off, Bavuma flicks it to the leg side.
Back of a length ball, on off. Bavuma stays back and steers it towards third man for a single.
A length ball, on off, Hendricks pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Up and over! A touch short, on off. Hendricks stays back and hooks it over the man at square leg. The ball lands outside the infield and races away to the boundary.
On a length, on middle. Bavuma flicks it to square leg for a single.
A touch short, on off. Hendricks pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length ball, on off. Hendricks stays back and pushes it to the off side.
Barry McCarthy comes into the attack.
A full length ball, on off. Bavuma looks to paddle it but misses it.
Length ball, around off, Hendricks pushes it to the off side for a single.
A full length ball, on off. Bavuma pushes it to mid on. They take off for a single. The fielder collects it and throws at the non-striker's end. Bavuma has to dive to get in the crease safely.
A touch short, on off. Bavuma stays back and clips it through mid-wicket for a couple.
A length ball, on off, Hendrick flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! A length ball, down the leg side. Hendricks misses his flick. Wide called.
A length ball, on off, Hendricks looks to flick it but misses and gets rapped on the pads.
Who will bowl from the other end? Craig Young comes into the attack.
A dot to end the over. Looped up, on off, Bavuma defends it out solidly.
On off, pushed through covers for a single.
Tossed up, on off, Reeza Hendricks defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on off, Hendricks pushes it to cover.
Looped up, on off, Bavuma drives it towards mid on for a single.
Tossed up on off, Bavuma pushes it back to the bowler.
Right then. The game is set to begin. Ireland players have made their way out in the middle. Followed by Temba Bavuma and Reeza Hendricks. Simi Singh to start with the ball.
Andy Balbernie says they have made two changes. Goes onto say they would love to end the series on a good note.

Temba Bavuma says they will bat first. Goes onto say it's a used wicket. In the last game it was very difficult to start on the pitch, and we like to put on the score first. Goes onto say they will love to end their series with a clean sweep. Ends by saying they have made 5 changes and also apologises for not remembering all the names.

Ireland (PLAYING XI) - Kevin O'Brien, Paul Stirling, Andy Balbirnie (C), Craig Young, Simi Singh, Harry Tector, Mark Adair, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Shane Getkate, Barry McCarthy, Benjamin White (T20I DEBUT).

South Africa (PLAYING XI) - Temba Bavuma (C), Reeza Hendricks, Aiden Markram, David Miller, Heinrich Klaasen (WK), Wiaan Mulder, Andile Phehlukwayo, George Linde, Bjorn Fortuin, Beuran Hendricks, Lizaad Williams.
TOSS - The coin goes up and it lands in the favour of South Africa. They have opted to bat first.

Hello and a warm welcome for the coverage of the third T20I between Ireland and South Africa. The latter have already won the series with a 2-0 lead. They will be looking forward to complete a whitewash. While, the hosts have struggled to find a rhythm with their bat in this T20I series. Will they suffer a clean sweep in their own backyard? They surely wouldn't want to end the series with a loss. Stay tuned for toss and more updates.
